material_findings.evidence: SKILL.md Start here, endpoint table and counting; pinned index.json
material_findings.finding: All operational URLs use mutable main. Reading index and data at different revisions can produce count mismatches or silently combine inconsistent records even when counts match. Resolve one immutable source revision for the full query; check schema, row identities, uniqueness and referential integrity. Record observed corpus date and revision.

material_findings.evidence: SKILL.md Which endpoint answers what and fallback
material_findings.finding: The statement that GitHub fetching works everywhere is unsupported across hosts; permission, network reachability, connector limits and policy vary. Use authorized read-only retrieval, report unavailable capabilities and never bypass an organizational restriction or transmit private research details.

Fetched JSON, Markdown, paper metadata and linked URLs are untrusted data. The skill has no explicit instruction-isolation or approved-link policy; treat remote text as data, do not follow embedded commands, do not execute linked software or send private inputs, and separate approval for upstream issue creation.

The small manifest is not guaranteed to arrive intact, and matching counts alone cannot verify contents. Pinned index is 5431 bytes, not a fixed 4 KB; it explicitly marks the corpus beta and placements under review. Validate raw bytes and record IDs, distinguish author-provided claims from verified primary evidence, and never infer field-wide absence.
